global_caption: The video contains 8 shots and is a realistic low-saturation perfume advertisement, primarily using cold gray-blue and soft sandy tones as the base palette. The visuals consistently maintain two unified lighting styles: morning mist natural light and seaside backlighting.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with fade-in from black, wide overhead composition spreading out coastal forest and thin mist layer by layer. Foreground shows dew-dampened low branches, midground leaves a misty path, focus on an elephant slowly emerging from the forest through mist. Morning mist partially obscures contours, creating deep depth layers. Natural diffused light wraps skin texture and moist air.
shot2: Shot 2 connects with previous shot via hard cut, close-up eye-level. Elephant’s trunk slowly enters frame from left, central focus on a perfume bottle with condensation droplets. Background remains hazy forest mist with shallow depth of field. Slightly blurred foreground grass forms leading lines. Focus locks onto moment trunk touches glass bottle. Cold natural light creates narrow highlight along bottle edge. Elephant moves with restraint and gentleness; tiny water droplets on bottle surface tremble slightly upon contact. Camera performs short push-in to enhance ritualistic feel.
shot3: Shot 3 connects with previous shot via hard cut, extreme close-up eye-level. Bottle occupies most of frame; blurred elephant skin in foreground serves as dark background. Focus centers on perfume liquid slowly flowing down bottle. Condensation and liquid merge on glass surface, forming clearer flow layers. Viscosity and refraction of liquid are emphasized. Camera makes slight lateral pan following liquid path. Emotion continues to tighten without showiness.
shot4: Shot 4 connects with previous shot via hard cut, close-up side view. Right side shows held-up perfume bottle, left side shows elephant ear and facial edge. Focus shifts instantly from nozzle to mist particles. Clear “咔嗒” appears when nozzle pressed. Fine mist sweeps over ear, forming silvery-gray floating particles under soft backlight. Ear edge subtly flutters. Fragrance mist briefly merges with morning mist. Camera performs brief lateral follow move matching spray action.
shot5: Shot 5 connects with previous shot via mist obstruction transition, wide full shot eye-level follow. Elephant has moved from forest to seaside dunes. Environment transition is natural and smooth. Background reveals broader coastline. Foreground shows wind-swept sand ripples. Focus remains on elephant’s direction of movement and elongated mist trail behind. Fragrance mist drags a long tail like a ribbon slowly pulled by air. Overall color remains low saturation, with only slight warm-cool brightness shift in sand reflection. Low-angle tracking shot enhances scale and forward momentum.
shot6: Shot 6 connects with previous shot via hard cut, medium-wide high-angle side-backlight. Morning sunlight penetrates from behind. Elephant stops at wet shoreline. Water vapor and fragrance mist overlap in air. Foreground features blurred waves creating spatial depth. Focus lies on semi-transparent mist layers and bottle silhouette glow under backlight. Sea breeze pushes mist diagonally toward sea surface. Elephant’s skin edges are softly outlined by backlight. Camera slowly tilts upward then gently pushes in.
shot7: Shot 7 connects with previous shot via fade-in/fade-out, composite overhead wide-to-close composition. Rock textures fill frame. Perfume bottle placed steadily before elephant’s front foot. Foreground shows damp rock surface with slight reflection. Midground product centered visually. Background sea foam glides across edge. Focus first locks on bottle, then shifts to dense Japanese text “深く、自由に、残る余韻” gradually pressing into upper and right areas. Typography uses large-scale screen overlay, semi-transparent cool white with light foggy relief texture. Entry animation features continuous flash and rapid stacking, resembling mist forming characters then gently vibrating. Camera performs slight vertical downward pressure. Bottle reflection and text flashes are precisely synchronized.
shot8: Shot 8 connects with previous shot via hard cut conclusion, extreme close-up eye-level. Both lie on same shallow depth plane. Background fully blurred into soft mist and bright bokeh. Final wisp of mist slowly dissipates. Lighting maintains controlled seaside backlight and cool mist fill. Frame nearly static, only air movement visible. Camera performs extremely slow push-in for final freeze-frame. Entire ad ends with sea breeze and lingering resonance.
